queries.Context: Core whole-brain activity measu: wide-field epifluorescence calcium imaging of whole-brain activity in 5-day-old zebrafish larvae immobilized in low-melting agarose, with manually selected brain regions of interest and delta F/F0 analysis of neuronal events and seizures
queries.Context: Neural activity reporter. Metho: wide-field calcium imaging of larval zebrafish whole brain using elavl3:GCaMP5G and elavl3:GCaMP6f transgenic lines to monitor neuronal activity and seizure dynamics in galanin signaling and epilepsy models
queries.Context: Causal manipulation of galanin: Genetic manipulation of galanin signaling in larval zebrafish using hsp70l:gal overexpression, gal knockout, and CRISPR galanin receptor crispants to examine whole-brain calcium activity and seizures
queries.Context: Testing galanin across differen: Galanin modulation of seizure activity in zebrafish larvae using eaat2a glutamate uptake mutants and pentylenetetrazole-induced seizures, with wide-field calcium imaging and galanin overexpression or knockout to assess whole-brain excitability and galr1a receptor contributions.
queries.Context: Baseline normal brain activity: Wide-field calcium imaging of larval zebrafish whole-brain activity across wild-type, hsp70l:gal galanin overexpression, gal knockout, galr1a crispants, with 5% 10% ΔF/F0 calcium event thresholds for event frequency, amplitude, duration.
queries.Context: Seizure-specific functional ana: Zebrafish larval wide-field calcium imaging of spontaneous eaat2a mutant seizures, acute pentylenetetrazole seizures, rebound pentylenetetrazole seizures, galanin overexpression, galanin knockout, seizure frequency, amplitude, duration, whole-brain excitability
queries.Context: Quantification of seizure event: Quantifying whole-brain seizure events in zebrafish larvae by wide-field calcium imaging, defining seizures as ΔF/F0 fluctuations above 100%, and measuring seizure number, amplitude, duration, and area under the curve
queries.Context: Receptor-subtype mechanism. Met: CRISPR-Cas9 F0 knockout of galr1a in larval zebrafish using multiple guide RNAs to determine receptor-specific galanin effects on whole-brain calcium activity and seizure susceptibility compared with complete galanin knockout
queries.Context: Molecular expression validation: quantitative real-time PCR measurement of galanin transcript levels in larval zebrafish brains across galanin overexpression, knockout, galr1a knockout, eaat2a mutant, and pentylenetetrazole seizure conditions using reference genes
queries.Context: Experimental rigor and inferenc: Experimental design, statistical inference, randomized allocation, appropriate controls, Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney tests for continuous variables, negative binomial regression for seizure count data in zebrafish larval galanin calcium imaging studies.
